releases.author: yushen110
releases.description:
## v1.1.0 — Apple-inspired UI Refresh

### ✨ New
- 🎨 Apple-style UI overhaul (rounded corners, shadows, smooth transitions)
- 🪟 Frosted glass selection highlight (follows theme accent color)
- 🔍 Pill-shaped search bar with focus glow
- 📖 Frosted glass preview panel

### 🐛 Fixed
- F2 rename now correctly captured inside the plugin
- Selected item content no longer shifts position
- Rename modal no longer forces cursor to start
- Removed rubber-band selection box (multi-selection preserved)

### 🚀 Improved
- Filter out Office temp files (`~$` prefix)
- Drive cards with hover lift animation
- Navigation buttons with press-scale animation
